lovable_check.detail: Both workspaces listed in full. No project is asiancoding.com. The only ACS project is 'ACS Prototype' (b1d14add), the five-page industrial-ID prototype created 7 Sep, which is unpublished and is not the corporate site. 'Ajungma Retail OS' is by ACS but its file tree is a POS application — no /brady/, /knowledge/ or barcode-scanner routes.
lovable_check.limitation: get_project does not expose custom domains at all — only preview_url and editor_url. A project serving asiancoding.com on a custom domain would therefore NOT be identifiable from this API by name. Absence here is not proof it is not on Lovable; it is proof it is not on THIS Lovable account under a recognisable name.
lovable_check.consistent_with_lovable: The live site is client-side rendered and serves only <title> to a non-JS crawler, which is what a Vite SPA does. The platform claim is plausible.
lovable_check.unblocks_if: The Owner supplies the Lovable project id that carries the asiancoding.com custom domain. Publishing is then a send_message to that project's agent.
